llmcord.py:287.why: the OpenAI client here is constructed dynamically inside on_message (llmcord.py:156) using whichever provider/model the server admin has selected via config.yaml or the /model command, so there is no single static client to migrate — wrapping the construction point lets every request attempt Router first and fall back per-request based on whether its model is a Router catalog id, without hardcoding any one provider's behavior.
